name: vault-orrery
description: Fly through your Obsidian vault as a star system.
//: No "type": "module" — Obsidian loads main.js as CommonJS, and declaring the package as ESM makes Node treat the built bundle as a module too. Build scripts use .mjs instead.

scripts.build: npm run engine && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/check-no-remote.mjs && node scripts/smoke.cjs
